name: Almost Heaven Bridgeport 6-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Bridgeport 6-Person Indoor Sauna If your mantra is “the more, the merrier,” then look no further than the Almost Heaven Bridgeport Indoor Sauna! With room for up to six people, this indoor sauna has multi-level benches and lots of space to stretch out. The Harvia 8kW electric heater can start heating the space right away, or you can delay the start time by up to eight hours. Regardless, you’ll be relaxing in temperatures of 180ºF. The Bridgeport Indoor Sauna is the largest indoor sauna with a rectangular shape that fits well in any basement, home gym, or bathroom. Sprinkle water on the hot sauna stones, stretch out on the top bench, and breathe deeply in the comfort of the Almost Heaven Braxton 6-Person Steam Sauna. Features Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8” finished thickness Pre-assembled wall and roof sections Utilizes the existing floor, suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Interior LED light Three benches, multi-level seating Indoor usage Hand-crafted construction Easy assembly for two people Best-in-class heater and sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the indoor sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to six people Heater size: 8kW, 240V, 40-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Exterior dimensions: 86″W x 63″D x 78″H Interior dimensions: 81″W x 58″D x 77″H Lower bench size: 81″L x 14″W x 22″H Upper bench size: 81″L x 22″W x 36″H Lower bench L extension: 24″L x 26″W x 22″H Door size: 64″H x 24″W Window size: 64″H x 17″W (2) Shipping size: 74″L x 40″W x 49″H Assembled weight: 845 lbs. Shipping weight: 850 lbs. Options and Customizations Lumber type: Choose between three different types of solid lumber. Rustic fir is light in color, with small knots creating a unique pattern on each piece. Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. Clear cedar is premium lumber, with knots noticeably absent. All three lumber options are 1 ⅜” thick to insulate the sauna room. Door style: Outfit your 6-person indoor sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, fading glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Heater: You can add the luxury and ease of WiFi controls with the Harvia KIP80W with a Xenio WiFi Control Panel. Shipping and Assembly The Bridgeport sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the 6-person indoor sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Care and Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior of your Bridgeport sauna after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Crafted with care, it offers ample space for six, making it perfect for families or groups. The high-quality sauna construction comes with options like rustic fir and cedar alongside a Harvia 8kW heater.
